revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 15.9% and FY2024 15.7%; fading growth toward maturity as subscriber and ad growth slow.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 29.5% (13,326.6/45,183.0), up from 26.7% FY2024; modest operating leverage to 31% held flat.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~13.7% (pretax 12,722.6 vs NI 10,981.2); raised to 17% as a conservative normalization.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex/revenue 1.52%, FY2024 1.13%; 1.4% in between.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta 1.1 x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran, 2026-02-16) = 9.8% cost of equity; ~97% equity weight, after-tax cost of debt ~4%; WACC ~9.5%. Beta is my assumption.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: lowered from 3.0% to 2.5% to reduce terminal-value dependence (VP flag); well below 4.86% risk-free rate, in line with long-run inflation plus modest real growth.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = (LT debt noncurrent 13,463.971 + short-term borrowings 998.865) - cash 9,033.681 - ST investments 28.678; acc. 0001065280-26-000034
